overview.Name: Origin Materials, Inc.
overview.Description: Origin Materials, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the polyethylene terephthalate (PET) closures business in California. It offers PET closure technology and products. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in West Sacramento, California.
